manufacturer.description:
The Recoil SAM65 6.5-inch 2-Way high-performance component speaker system delivers unequivocal sound quality and performance for the most enhanced listening experience. Embodying the most innovative and exclusive driver technologies, drawing from our latest advances in speaker design, Recoil’s SAM65 speaker is more powerful, more refined, and more sophisticated, and set a new performance benchmark.

Furthermore, these SAM65 component speakers feature 1-inch high-fidelity silk dome tweeters that deliver incredibly rich, crystal-clear highs. SAM65 comes with audiophile quality two-way passive crossovers. Only the highest quality components selected solely on the basis of their sonic properties are utilized. manufacturer.shortDescription:
About this item: 

 🔥  BIGGER MIDRANGE, BIGGER PRESENCE: 

The  RM8-4P  delivers an 8" pro-style midrange driver that fills the critical 90Hz–5kHz frequency range with authority. Unlike standard 6.5" speakers, this 8" monster moves more air – producing richer vocals, punchier instrumentals, and a wider soundstage that transforms your car audio system.

 💪  SERIOUS POWER HANDLING: 

Rated at  150W RMS (300W Max) per pair  at 4Ω impedance. Whether driven by a dedicated midrange amp or a high-power channel from your DSP processor, the RM8-4P handles serious power without distortion – outperforming factory speakers by a wide margin.

 🎚️  HIGH-EFFICIENCY PRO PERFORMANCE: 

With  92dB sensitivity  (±3dB), these 8" midrange speakers produce exceptional volume from moderate power. Perfect for systems using factory head units, external amplifiers, or active crossover networks. The ferrite magnet (21oz) provides rock-solid motor strength for tight, accurate response.

 🛡️  PRO-GRADE DURABILITY & MATERIALS: 

 

• Pressed Paper Fiber Cone – Delivers natural, warm acoustic response without harshness 

• KSV Voice Coil (38.5mm / 1.5") – Heat-resistant coil withstands extended high-power sessions 

• Cloth Suspension – Provides excellent durability and controlled cone movement 

• 21oz Ferrite Magnet – High-blux motor structure for improved transient response 

 📏  DROP-IN READY WITH FLEXIBLE INSTALLATION: 

The RM8-4P fits most 8" factory locations, custom door panels, kick panels, or sealed/pod enclosures. Check dimensions before ordering (Mounting depth: 67mm / 2.64"; Cutout diameter: 200mm / 7.87"). Perfect for upgrading factory 8" midbass drivers or building a pro-style 3-way active front stage.

 Product Description (Long Description – For A+ Content or Enhanced Brand Content) 

 Engineered for the Active Enthusiast 

 The RECOIL AUDIO Red Storm Series RM8-4P is an 8" pro-style midrange speaker designed for car audio enthusiasts who demand more. More output. More presence. More realism.

 Unlike coaxials that compromise with built-in tweeters, the RM8-4P is a dedicated midrange driver – optimized for active systems where you control the crossover points. Pair it with a subwoofer (80Hz and below) and a set of tweeters (5kHz and above) to build a world-class 3-way active front stage.

 Why Choose 8" Midrange? 

 Larger cone area equals more air movement. The RM8-4P's 8" pressed paper fiber cone moves significantly more air than 6.5" drivers, resulting in:

 

• Fuller vocal reproduction 

• Greater midbass impact 

• Higher output before distortion 

 Built to Last 

 Every component is selected for reliability in the demanding car audio environment. The KSV voice coil resists heat buildup during long drives. The cloth suspension maintains compliance year after year. The ferrite magnet never loses its charge.

manufacturer.title: PX65.4 - Pro Audio Neo Coaxial Speakers
manufacturer.description:
The PX65.4 is a 6.5" neodymium coaxial speaker built for high-output applications where both power handling and tonal accuracy matter. With a 300W peak / 150W RMS rating and a 95 dB sensitivity, it delivers loud, low-distortion audio without demanding excessive amplifier headroom. Its broad 110 Hz – 20 kHz coverage simplifies system design by reducing the need for additional mid-range support.

 
 
• 
 Neodymium magnet motor: Lightweight, high-strength magnet structure for improved efficiency and output relative to ferrite equivalents. 
 
• 
 95 dB sensitivity: High sensitivity rating means more output per watt, making it compatible with a wide range of amplifiers. 
 
• 
 300W peak / 150W RMS power handling: Handles sustained power without thermal compression in demanding installs. 
 
• 
 110 Hz – 20 kHz frequency response: Wide bandwidth covers critical midrange and high-frequency content in a single driver. 
 
• 
 1.52" (38.5mm) voice coil: Larger coil diameter improves heat dissipation and power handling over standard coaxials. 
 
• 
 Waterproof paper cone: Adventure-ready construction suited for exposed or high-humidity environments. 
 
• 
 4-ohm impedance: Standard impedance compatible with most aftermarket amplifiers and head units.

manufacturer.shortDescription:
About this item: 

 

 Precision 5-Way Frequency Splitting 

Recoil car audio crossover professionally divides audio signals into 5 optimized bands (LOW/LOW MID/HIGH MID/HIGH + Pass Thru) with adjustable crossovers (30Hz-20KHz), eliminating frequency overlap for crystal-clear staging.

  

 Studio-Grade Sound Purity 

Ultra-low 0.01% THD noise floor and 85dB crosstalk rejection preserve signal integrity, delivering studio-reference sound in your vehicle.

  

 Deep Bass Optimization System 

Exclusive triple-bass control:

•  Subsonic Filter  (Bypass/40/60/80Hz) protects subs

•  Bass Boost  (+10dB @40Hz) enhances kick drums

•  Phase Inverter  (0°/180°) eliminates cancellation

  

 Plug-Play Pro Installation 

Integrated input selector (SUB/LOW or FRONT/REAR), remote turn-on lead, and color-coded RCA jacks.  No DSP programming needed  – set up in 15 mins!

  

 Industrial-Grade Reliability 

Military-spec circuit protection (reverse polarity/overload) in aluminum chassis (224x116x30mm). Backed by 12-month warranty against defects.

manufacturer.title: DMBK Professional Grade 90mil 36sqft Car Sound Deadening mat – Butyl Automotive Sound Deadener – Noise Insulation and Vibration Dampening Material (90 mil ) with included roller and knife
manufacturer.shortDescription:
Recoil sound-dampening material is key to reducing the rattles and shakes in your car. It effectively reduces the amount of road noise that is let in through the thin panels of your vehicle. It also lessens vibrations that are created by playing music through your speakers. It works by adding weight to the desired panel, which lowers the resonating frequency.

 Recoil Professional Grade 90mil dampening mat is 1,8 times thicker in comparison to other dampening mats of 50 mils, which will get you 1,8 times more effective insulation. The thicker the material the more performance you get.

 Recoil damping mat consists of an advanced formulation of 99.9% pure white butyl, unlike other materials made of black recycled butyl.Recoil damping mat is easy to install with a “peel and place” application. Simply trim the pieces to fit, peel and place and hand roll to ensure good adhesion.

 Specifications — Thickness 90 mil, Coverage area 36 sqft, Number of sheets in the box 9, Each sheet size 18”x32”.

 The included Recoil dampening mat roller is made of a corrugated rotating wheel, which helps to better operate and prevent the drum from slipping. Its ergonomic handle is comfortable to use. The included Recoil knife helps to trim the mat into pieces to fit panels.

manufacturer.title: MLOC2 2-Channel Smart Micro Line Output Converter with 10V Output and 12V Remote Turn-On Trigger and 60 Ohm Load Impedance
manufacturer.description:
Add an amplifier to nearly any radio with Recoil MLOC2 Stereo Line-Out Converter. Experience true sonic accuracy at any volume level with all the sparkling highs and thunderous lows of your original audio. Unlike traditional LOCs the MLOC2 is designed without inductors to deliver a completely flat 20Hz-20kHz frequency response at all volume levels. Using nothing more than your factory speaker wires the innovative MLOC2 automatically converts the speaker signal into both an RCA signal and a powerful 100 milli-amp 12-volt remote wire using DC offset. Powerful enough to turn on multiple amplifiers the 12-volt remote wire delivers plenty of power without hunting for a switched 12-volt power source. Accepts up to 80 watts (20 volts) of the input signal and delivers up to an 10-volt output signal.

 Why do I need a smart LOC?

Today’s modern OEM smart radios have incorporated a protection circuit that will shut off or distort audio on one or more channels if the load on the OEM radio is not within a specific impedance range. This Recoil smart LOC features 60 Ohm load which is fully compatible with standard radios and most smart radios.
manufacturer.shortDescription:
The World’s smallest 2-channel micro speaker cable to RCA line output converter. Use MLOC2 when adding an amplifier to a factory radio to convert the radio’s speaker level output to the low amplifier (RCA) level input

Takes as much as 80 Watts of the input signal and delivers up to 10 volts of output. Flat 20Hz-20kHz frequency range at all volume levels

Features 60 Ohm Loads to ensure uninterrupted audio playback when used with most OEM smart radios.

The speaker wire is made of 99.99% oxygen-free copper for superior bass response and signal clarity.

Provides 12-volt for amplifier remote turn on with LED indicator.

Super compact design allows for easy installation.

manufacturer.title: PCK8 Premium 8AWG Complete Wiring Kits
manufacturer.description:
Recoil Premium OFC Kits Introduction 

 Looking for a true 8-gauge oxygen free copper amp wiring kit? Recoil is proud to introduce the PCK8 8 Gauge Amplifier Wiring Installation Kit. This package includes everything you need, including RCA cable and speaker wire, to get your amp powered-up properly and running at its peak efficiency.

 Recoil chose to utilize top-quality materials throughout the kit, including true oxygen-free copper power, ground, RCA and speaker wire. This full copper wire helps prevent signal and power loss through the entire audio system, allowing your amplifier and components to operate to their fullest. The ultra-durable and flexible outer jacket makes installation and routing of the cable a breeze.

 The superior quality and materials of Recoil also shows in the included accessories. The solid brass and satin chrome plated Mini-ANL Fuse holder with a 60 amp Mini-ANL fuse, protecting you from costly power surges or grounding issues. The power wire comes wrapped in 6 feet of durable nylon braided tubing to protect it from heat and chafing in the engine bay. Even simple installation accessories such as the spade connectors are nickel plated for superior long-term durability and signal transfer.

 Flexibility 

Recoil stranded wire is extremely tolerant of the rough conditions in vehicles and compensates for vibration, heat expansion and flexibility. This flexible but well shielded wire is crucial for getting through all of the nooks and passage ways within the cramped confines of vehicle interiors.

 Cable Thickness 

The thickness of the actual wire, not the insulation, is critical when it comes to transferring the extraordinary current of your audio system. With hundreds of strands of wire in one cable you get an increased current flow and a higher amperage carrying capacity with a reduced cable size.

 Insulation Material 

Recoil insulation hinders electric current from exiting the wire prematurely which prevents electrocution and damage to components within the vehicle. Additionally, the insulation maintains the flexibility of the wire while preventing corrosion and damage in the hostile vehicle environment.

manufacturer.title: RCK4 - Complete 4 Gauge 2-channel Amplifier Installation Kit
manufacturer.description:
The RCK4 Echo Wire Kit delivers a complete 4 gauge, 2-channel amplifier installation solution built around CCA power wiring and genuine OFC RCA interconnects — a practical combination that keeps costs down without compromising signal integrity. The 17ft frosted blue power wire and helical-twisted RCA cable are sized for mid-to-high powered amplifier installs where clean routing and reliable connectivity matter. Everything needed to go from battery to amp is included in a single kit.

 
 
• 
 4 Gauge CCA Power & Ground Wire: 17ft frosted blue power wire and 3ft black ground wire, each terminated with ring terminals for direct battery and chassis connections. 
 
• 
 OFC RCA Interconnect: 17ft, 2-channel helical-twisted cable constructed from 99.99% oxygen-free copper strands for low-noise signal transfer. 
 
• 
 ANL/Mini-ANL Fuse Holder: Zinc die-cast, satin chrome-plated holder with a 120A ANL fuse included, protecting against power surges and grounding faults. 
 
• 
 16 Gauge Speaker Wire: 25ft of frosted blue/black wire for running channels from amplifier to speakers. 
 
• 
 Nickel-Plated Terminals: Four 4 gauge ring terminals and five 18 gauge spade terminals, all with color-coded boots for polarity identification. 
 
• 
 Complete Hardware Included: 18 gauge remote turn-on lead, rubber firewall grommet, butt connector, and ten zip ties.

manufacturer.title: PW4-80 Premium True Spec 4 Gauge Power Wire, 99.9% Oxygen-Free Pure Copper , Flexible Soft Touch Red PVC Jacket (80 Feet/Spool)
manufacturer.description:
80 feet of 4 AWG, 1862 strands of 99.99% Oxygen-Free pure copper wire

Pure oxygen-free copper material helps prevent power loss through the entire audio system, allowing your amplifier and components to operate to their fullest.

Super flexible soft touch red PVC jacket for fast and easy installation

Comes with our patented modular wire spool and rack system. This spool and racks can be assembled vertically or horizontally. You can assemble them to fit into tight corners, put them on the shelf, build a merchandising display rack, or put them on a slat wall.

The spools are designed with bearings. It is easy to slide them in & out of the slots on the rack. And you can pull or roll the wire smoothly and quietly.
manufacturer.shortDescription:
Recoil Premium Power/Ground Wire 

 Looking for true oxygen-free copper power & ground wires? Recoil is proud to introduce our premium Echo PRO spool wires.

 Recoil chose to utilize top-quality materials. This full copper wire helps prevent power loss through the entire audio system, allowing your amplifier and components to operate to their fullest. The ultra-durable and flexible outer jacket makes installation and routing of the cable a breeze.

 Recoil-stranded wire is extremely tolerant of the rough conditions in vehicles and compensates for vibration, heat expansion, and flexibility.

 The thickness of the actual wire, not the insulation, is critical when it comes to transferring the extraordinary current of your audio system. With hundreds of strands of wire in one cable, you get an increased current flow and a higher amperage carrying capacity.

 Additionally, the insulation maintains the flexibility of the wire while preventing corrosion and damage in a hostile vehicle environment.

About this item:

 🔹 INSTANTLY SILENCE ANNOYING AMP "POP" SOUNDS

Program 0-30 second delays for each of the 4 outputs to stagger amp turn-on/off. No more explosive speaker pops!

🔹 REAL-TIME VOLTAGE GUARDIAN – STOP BATTERY DRAIN!

Built-in voltage meter. Protects your battery from dying if voltage drops too low.

🔹 4-CHANNEL SMART POWER HUB

Cleanly power 4 amplifiers/devices from a single source. Forged brass terminals ensure zero voltage loss.

🔹 EMERGENCY FUSE KIT INCLUDED

Built-in with spare fuses + fuse wrench – replace blown fuses on the road in seconds.
manufacturer.shortDescription:
Introduction:

Fuse holders and distribution blocks haven’t been changed for decades.

 Recoil Audio introduced the lasted and patent pending smart fuse blocks. This is a 4-way fuse & ground combo block with voltmeter and adjustable remote sequencer outputs.

 True audio enthusiast understands the importance of optimizing and maintaining voltage levels in your vehicle’s audio system. Its built-in adjustable remote sequencer outputs ensure that your system powers on smoothly, eliminating any unwanted pop-on & pop-off noise.

 Why do you need it?

"Tired of that embarrassing POP every time you start your car? Our delay tech makes it vanish."

"Scared your subwoofers will kill your battery? Set voltage limits – pop out warning message before it’s too late."

"Hate messy wiring? One block powers 4 amplifiers or devices. Clean install. Zero chaos."

"Stranded by a blown fuse? Included spares fuses + tool get you back booming fast."

manufacturer.description:
Recoil fuse block offers a space-saving and cost-effective solution to adding circuit protection. This 12-way ATC/ATO fuse block allows you to supply power to your new accessories without compromising your stock wiring. It is perfect for cleaning up the wiring on your car, truck, boat, or any vehicle. It comes with 12 fuse-protected terminals for up to 100 amps of power, and tin-plated copper components for improved conductivity and corrosion resistance.

 12-circuit fuse block accepts ATO® and ATC® fast acting blade fuses

 Tin-plated copper buses and fuse clips for maximum power transfer

 Positive distribution bus with #10-32 studs

 Accepts ring or snap fork-type terminals

 The polycarbonate cover incorporates an easy-to-open push button latch providing easy access to fuses

 24pcs fuses, two spare screws, and a fuse tool are included for easy replacement in the field, including circuit sticker labels.

 What's Included? 

 

 (1) 12-Way Fuse Box

 (8) 20A Fuses (8) 15A Fuses (4) 10A Fuses (4) 5A Fuses

 (2) #10 Spare Screws

 (1) Fuse Clamp Tool

 (1) Pack of Label Stickers

 (4) Stainless Steel Screws

manufacturer.title: WF012 FERRULES & HEAT SHRINK TUBING KITS
manufacturer.description:
1/0 AWG ferrules and heat shrink tubing

 Six pairs

 Silver plated

 6 red & 6 black 3:1 heat shrink ratio tubing
manufacturer.shortDescription:
Recoil offers ferrules for professional installers, these connectors are small deformable metal tubes made out of silver or tin plated copper.

 While the flexibility of stranded wire allows for much easier routing, the ends tend to splay apart. Once crimped with Recoil ferrules, the bundle is transformed into a solid-core wire. Ferrules greatly reduce the contact resistance between the wire and connector, and even help cut down on the oxidation in the strands because of the lack of air space between them.

 Why do you need car audio capacitors? 

 A loud and bassy car audio system is great, but it can also hinder other parts of your vehicle. manufacturer.title: MST1 - Multifunctional Audio Tester
manufacturer.description:
The Recoil MST-1 is a multifunctional audio tester built for technicians and enthusiasts who need a single, portable tool to handle signal testing, voltage measurement, phase checking, and continuity verification. It covers the full diagnostic workflow for car audio installations — from source to speaker — without requiring multiple separate instruments. A built-in rechargeable lithium battery and auto shutoff make it practical for real-world shop or install-bay use.

 
 
• 
 Tone Generator: Outputs a 5V signal across a frequency range of 13Hz to 10kHz for signal path tracing and system testing. 
 
• 
 Voltage Measurement: Reads constant DC voltage up to 32V and AC voltage up to 36V, plus AC music signal voltage. 
 
• 
 Phase Testing: Verifies speaker and system phase to confirm correct polarity throughout the signal chain. 
 
• 
 Continuity Testing: Checks wire and signal cable continuity to quickly identify breaks or faults. 
 
• 
 Resistance Measurement: Built-in resistance meter for speaker and circuit diagnostics. 
 
• 
 Backlit LCD Display: Illuminated screen for clear readings in low-light environments. 
 
• 
 Included Accessories: Ships with RCA connectors and alligator clips for flexible connection to audio components.

manufacturer.shortDescription:
About this item: 

 

• Recoil ES6 is a IP67 waterproof rating 6-Zone  switch box, features the latest MOSFET™ chips to handle total 700-watt  power handling: Ch 1&2: 200W each, Ch 3&4: 100W each. Ch 5&6: 50W eac Each channel features individual fuse protection. 

• This control box offers two control options: 6-button Carling-style switch & App-controlled. The EZ SWITCH A pp (iOS/Android) unlocks wireless dimming, master On/Off switch, independent zone control, strobe, and music-sync light shows. 

• This switch box can be flush mounted or surface mounted, while the 6-button Carling-style switch can be snap-into standard pre-cutout. The kit includes Polaris® vehicle switch adapter, spare fuses, tools, and mounting hardware. 

• Engineered for serious adventurers, this IPX7waterproof switch hub dominates harsh environments – from desert trails to torrential downpours – thanks to its waterproof housing design and conformal coated PCBA. 

• Package includes: ES6 Control Box ×1, Snap-in Switch Panel ×1, Wiring Harness ×1, Fuse Kit ×1, Polaris® Adapter ×1, Mounting Hardware ×1

manufacturer.shortDescription:
About this item: 

 CABLE MANAGEMENT SET – Enhance your space's organization with our patent pending modular cable management set, which includes 100pcs sturdy 0.75" x 0.75"  black mounts,  200pcs Zip Ties, 100pcs stainless-steel tapping screws , perfect for securing and managing wires efficiently.

 𝗦𝗖𝗥𝗘𝗪𝗦 = 𝗦𝗧𝗥𝗢𝗡𝗚𝗘𝗥 𝗛𝗢𝗟𝗗 𝗧𝗛𝗔𝗡 𝗔𝗗𝗛𝗘𝗦𝗜𝗩𝗘 – Ensure zip tie mount stays where you put it with screws. It provides a strong screw anchor for your cable. No more wire bundles and mounts falling after days of use.

 SIZES – Designed to hold  4-gauge to 8-gauge  wire, or a bundle of wire. The included zip ties and stainless-steel screws are made specifically to fit these bases. No need to search through your toolbox or go out and buy screws hoping they fit.

 MODULAR & 𝗗 UAL SLOTS DESIGN – Thanks to its modular design. Recoil zip tie mounts can be easily assembled as side-by-side, L-shape, T-shape or Cross shape. Use two zip ties to bundle your cable securely & tightly to these anchored bases for a seamless and efficient installation.

 HIGH QUALITY BUILD  – Made from superior UL approved Nylon 66, Operating temperature of -40°F to +185°F.

 VERSATILE USE  – Suitable for both indoor and outdoor environments, Recoil zip tie mounts perform excellently in various settings such as home offices and workshops. They are great for organizing cables under desks or securing outdoor lighting and electrical setups.

manufacturer.title: SRL500 Microprocessor Controlled 500A Smart Battery Isolator and High Current Starter Relay, Dual Sensing Smart Relay, with Ring Terminals
manufacturer.description:
SRL500 handles 500 Amps continuous at 12V and 700 Amps Surge.

 Eliminates multiple battery drain as it stops the battery bank from getting power from each one and extends battery life. It prevents the equipment from discharging the main battery when it is operated while the engine is off.

 Microprocessor-controlled smart relay does not create a voltage drop to the second battery like a conventional isolator.

 Once the main battery reaches 13.2V, the smart relay connects two batteries. Once the system drops below 12.7V, it disconnects two batteries.

 The dual sensing feature allows charging both ways if the auxiliary battery is charged by the external power source.

 A waterproof manual override switch allows you to connect two batteries with the push of a button for 60 seconds.

 Excellent waterproof performance, high quality in any weather conditions. Two 1/0AWG copper ring terminals and heat shrink tubing are included for easy installation.
